name: CLBench

results_over_time.note: Paper Table 2, overall Solving Rate across 4 categories. Scores are binary rubric-based accuracy (avg 63.2 rubrics per context). Category-level scores also reported: Domain Knowledge Reasoning, Rule System Application, Procedural Task Execution, Empirical Discovery & Simulation. All rows are bare LLM; no agent scaffold tested in paper's Table 2.

notes: 500 complex contexts, 1,899 tasks, 31,607 verification rubrics, all authored/refined by domain experts. Tests whether LMs can learn new knowledge from provided context (fictional worldbuilding / modified real knowledge / niche emerging knowledge) and apply reasoning. 4 context categories: Domain Knowledge Reasoning (39.2%), Rule System Application (28%), Procedural Task Execution (14%), Empirical Discovery & Simulation (16%). `used_llm_or_agent=llm` because evaluation is single-pass context → answer; no tool use or agent loop.
